correctness.notes: oracle passed on every measured cell | 118 cells reported unsupported by the adapter's supported(), listed in correctness.unsupported_cells | 120 cells dropped for lack of a control value (a cell-list batch run under the other requirement carries the same cells without the reference's path, their twins with a control are in the card), for example N1024 k32 bf16 prefer_smaller_index latency | phase 3 final evaluation, harness 0.10, 0.11, nodes umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094 | cells come from more than one node, see the node field of every cell: umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094

low_level: Registers 32 to 255 over the 575 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (186 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 2160 to 104528 bytes, harness 0.10, 0.11 on umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094.
Adapter statics: input arrangement blocked, output indices, temp storage 2128 to 71760 bytes.

algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on umbriel-b200-047): latency not_guaranteed wins 11 of 77 cells (runner-up in 6), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 15 of 75 cells (runner-up in 19), throughput not_guaranteed wins 2 of 84 cells (runner-up in 5), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 11 of 74 cells (runner-up in 21).

Where it wins on random input (bf16 N 1024, bf16 N 4096, bf16 N 16384, bf16 N 32768, fp32 N 4096, fp32 N 8192, fp32 N 16384, fp32 N 32768), the median margin over the runner-up is +23 percent and over the scope's reference control +69 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): bf16 N 16384 k 4 +1126 percent behind B2_twolevel in latency not_guaranteed, bf16 N 32768 k 4 +967 percent behind B2_twolevel in latency prefer_smaller_index, fp32 N 16384 k 4 +519 percent behind B2_twolevel in latency prefer_smaller_index, bf16 N 4096 k 4 +459 percent behind B2_twolevel in latency prefer_smaller_index.

negative: No cell where this adapter was the winner changed hands against the control in the same lock section. Deficits above are against other adapters of the same scope.
